question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Fantastic
solution:
The correct answer is: **Fanciful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Fantastic"** means something extraordinary, imaginative, or unrealistic; often associated with ideas or things that are whimsical or extravagant. (अद्भुत, कल्पनात्मक)

 
 
• **Example:** The movie portrayed a fantastic world filled with magical creatures and breathtaking landscapes.
 
 
 
• **"Fanciful"** refers to something imaginative, whimsical, or based on fantasy rather than reality. It shares the same essence as "Fantastic" in this context. (अद्भुत, कल्पनाशील)
 
 
• **Example:** The artist painted a fanciful scene of a castle floating in the sky surrounded by clouds.
 
 
 
• Hence, "Fantastic" and "Fanciful" are synonymous in meaning.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Fanciful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Practical** (व्यवहारिक): Related to real-life applications or being sensible and realistic.

 
 
• **Example:** He gave a practical solution to the complex problem.
 
 
 
• **Graceful** (सुंदर): Exhibiting elegance, charm, or beauty in movement or appearance.
 
 
• **Example:** The dancer performed with graceful movements that mesmerized the audience.
 
 
 
• **Delicate** (नाजुक): Something fragile or requiring careful handling.
 
 
• **Example:** The delicate flowers need special care to thrive in harsh weather.
 
 

3d:Tcb4,

The correct answer is: **Option 1**.
